trajectory_summary: The call opens with real promise — the customer volunteers a $429 bill and a stated interest in government solar incentives within the first two minutes — but the rep pivots to the credit qualifier almost immediately and, once the customer reveals a sub-670 score, closes the call out entirely rather than exploring alternatives or owning a follow-up. The energy that was built in the first 90 seconds leaks out completely by the end.
outcome_dispute: This should be tagged dq (credit) rather than a generic no_appointment/callback — the rep explicitly ended pursuit of the appointment on the stated credit answer per qualifiers.credit_qualifier, but did so without confirming a hard callback time, which also makes this an unanchored_soft_exit within the DQ.
